decision_rationale: The paper describes a new tri-modal foundation model and explicitly states a decoder-based generative backbone and autoregressive token space. It also reports pretraining on a large multimodal corpus with broad zero-shot generalization and cross-task transfer.
evidence_snippet: "shared autoregressive token space"; "decoder-based generative backbone"; "language-centred multimodal foundation model"; "three-stage progressive training"; "zero-shot generalization"; "pretraining" on 1.05 million images and 39.85 million text sentences, plus 151,182 tri-modal pairs}]}
